lines.beaver: 민수야, 요즘 얼굴이 좋아 보이네. 무슨 일 있어?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, you look great lately. What's up?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsuya, yojeum eolguri joa boine. Museun il isseo?
lines.learner: 응, 일자리 구하던 차에 좋은 소식이 생겼어.
lines.en: Yeah, just as I was job hunting, I got good news.
lines.roman: Eung, iljari guhadeon chae joeun sosigi saenggyeosseo.

lines.learner: 네가 소개해 준 분 덕분에 면접을 봤어.
lines.en: I got an interview thanks to the person you introduced.
lines.roman: Nega sogaehae jun bun deokbune myeonjeobeul bwasseo.

lines.beaver: 아, 박 선배 말이야? 별거 아니었어.
lines.beaver_en: Oh, Mr. Park? It was nothing.
lines.beaver_roman: A, bak seonbae mariya? Byeolgeo anieosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Good. He said he liked you too.
lines.learner: 합격할 것 같아. 다 네 덕분이야.
lines.en: I think I'll pass. It's all thanks to you.
lines.roman: Hapgyeokal geot gata. Da ne deokbuniya.

lines.beaver: 그런 말 마. 우리 사이에 뭘.
lines.beaver_en: Don't say that. Between us, it's nothing.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureon mal ma. Uri saie mwol.
lines.en: No matter how close we are, I want to repay you.

lines.beaver: 그럼 맛있는 밥 한번 사 줘.
lines.beaver_en: Then buy me a nice meal sometime.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom masinneun bap hanbeon sa jwo.
lines.learner: 좋아. 넌 힘들 때 늘 힘을 북돋아 줬잖아.
lines.en: Sure. You always lifted me up when things were hard.
lines.roman: Joa. Neon himdeul ttae neul himeul bukdoda jwotjana.

lines.beaver: 나도 작년에 떨어져 봐서 마음 알지.
lines.beaver_en: I failed last year too, so I know how it feels.
lines.beaver_roman: Nado jangnyeone tteoreojyeo bwaseo maeum alji.
lines.learner: 맞아, 동병상련이라 더 큰 위안이 됐어.
lines.en: Right, we'd been through the same, so it was a big comfort.
lines.roman: Maja, dongbyeongsangnyeonira deo keun wiani dwaesseo.

lines.beaver_en: What do you think true friendship is?
lines.learner: 말 안 해도 아는 이심전심이 우정 같아.
lines.en: I think friendship is understanding without words.
lines.roman: Mal an haedo aneun isimjeonsimi ujeong gata.

lines.learner: 도움받은 걸 잊지 않는 의리도 중요해.
lines.en: Loyalty, never forgetting help you got, matters too.
lines.roman: Doumbadeun geol itji anneun uirido jungyohae.

lines.beaver_en: I miss our hometown friends too.
lines.learner: 다음 달에 다 같이 만나자. 내가 살게!
lines.en: Let's all meet up next month. My treat!
lines.roman: Daeum dare da gachi mannaja. Naega salge!
